title: incident-bot: SLO toolkit escalation context enrichment + runbook helpers
author: Priya Singh
commits: feat: add escalation context enrichment pipeline (context_enricher.py)
feat: runbook helper utilities for quicklinks and scoring (runbook/helpers.py)
feat: expose runbook scoring to slo-toolkit utils (slo-toolkit/utils/runbook_scoring.py)
docs: add operational runbooks guide and examples (docs/incident-bot/operational-runbooks.md)
test: add unit tests for enricher + helpers, CI updates
chore: minor lint fixes and type annotations
description:
Motivation: on-call responders need richer context when SLOs are flapping or breached. This PR wires the SLO toolkit into incident-bot so that escalation payloads include prioritized runbook quicklinks, SLO scoring, and contextual hints derived from recent diagnostics. The goal is to reduce time-to-detect-and-remediate by surfacing the most relevant runbooks and a short playbook snippet in the notification.

What this changes: adds a context enrichment pipeline (incident-bot/src/slo/context_enricher.py) that consumes SLO signals and a small cache of recent diagnostics, computes a runbook relevance score using sla heuristics (moved/extended into slo-toolkit/utils/runbook_scoring.py), and augments incident payloads with: 1) top-3 runbook quicklinks, 2) a 2-3 sentence summary snippet from the chosen runbook template, and 3) an estimated remediation confidence score. Also introduces runbook helper utilities (incident-bot/src/runbook/helpers.py) to canonicalize runbook metadata, generate short snippets, and resolve canonical links for on-call UIs.

Backwards compatibility & migration: enrichment is behind a feature flag (ENRICH_SLO_CONTEXT). When disabled there is no change to existing payload shapes. The runbook scoring API in slo-toolkit is additive and exposes a stable function signature (score_runbooks(context, candidates)) that callers can opt into. No DB migrations.

Testing: added unit tests for scoring heuristics and content extraction (incident-bot/tests/*). CI was updated to run a light integration test (ci.yml) that simulates an SLO breach and asserts the enrichment fields appear when the feature flag is on.

Operational notes: feature flag rollout recommended: enable in staging for 48h, then gradual rollout to production for non-critical teams. The enrichment adds ~25ms p95 to enrichment pipeline; we measured 5-15ms median on a small sample. If load-sensitive, enable caching of resolved runbook snippets (configurable TTL).

Checklist: [x] Unit tests added, [x] CI green, [x] Docs updated, [x] Feature-flagged, [x] No breaking changes

Related: ENG-2876 (improve SLO responder experience), SRE-145 (on-call runbook discoverability).
